questions: Are you fully awake and aware of what is happening right now?
Do you remember all of the movements shown in the video?
Were these movements involuntary and difficult to control?
Have you had similar episodes before?
Did you lose consciousness at any point?
Did you become confused or unusually sleepy afterward?
Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder?
Did you have weakness, numbness, facial drooping, or difficulty speaking?
Did you have a severe headache, fever, or neck stiffness?
Did you experience chest pain, shortness of breath, faintness, or palpitations?
Were the movements associated with abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medications?
Have you used alcohol, recreational drugs, or accidentally taken extra medication recently?
Do you have a history of seizures, stroke, diabetes, or other neurological disease?
